milestone: M46 Headless Mode Pack Update Continuation

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets headless.continue_once perform one authorized, replay-safe Mode Pack candidate fetch/cache step from latest trusted registry selection evidence.
Binds the delegated candidate fetch to the selected registry candidate URL/content/policy/provenance/signer fingerprints already persisted by the Rust runtime.
Requires explicit headless continuation authorization and selected-candidate fetch authorization, and fails closed before network/cache mutation on stale or mismatched evidence.
Persists bounded continuation checkpoint evidence and replays without duplicating candidate fetch/cache ledger events or exposing raw registry/candidate/provenance data.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can execute one trusted registry-selection-bound Mode Pack candidate fetch/cache continuation and return the bounded fetch result plus explicit provenance-verification route.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: modepack.fetchCandidate can fetch caller-supplied URLs, and M45.1 can select a trusted registry candidate, but no runtime-owned continuation binds the latest selection evidence to the fetch/cache side effect and replay checkpoint.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Autonomous Mode Pack update loops would still need manual glue between trusted registry selection and candidate cache acquisition, leaving replay and latest-selection validation outside the runtime continuation authority.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. R5.1 hardened fetch DNS, R5.2 bound active candidate identity, and M45.1 enforced registry trust before selection; M46.1 executes the next selected-candidate fetch step through headless continuation.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once request/response shape is extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase uses bounded continuation checkpoint evidence and the existing ModePackFetchCandidateResult rather than adding a report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or verdict surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates fresh progress, explicit target authorization, latest trusted registry selection evidence, active Mode Pack snapshot identity, candidate fingerprints, then delegates exactly one candidate fetch/cache side effect and replays without duplicate fetch.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled headless caller can move from registry-selected update evidence to cached candidate acquisition with deterministic next_action for provenance verification.
answers.milestone_progress: Starts M46 by making the first Mode Pack update pipeline continuation executable under headless.continue_once.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M46.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M46.1 value gate. Review must confirm this is headless selected-candidate fetch execution, not a report/readiness wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts one bounded modepack_selected_candidate_fetch_target with explicit authorization and fresh progress evidence
runtime revalidates selection id/event id, registry manifest hash, selected candidate URL/content/policy/provenance/signer fingerprints, and active activation fingerprint before fetch/cache mutation

successful continuation delegates to the existing Mode Pack candidate fetch/cache path and returns bounded ModePackFetchCandidateResult with next_action verify_selected_modepack_candidate_provenance_explicitly
same continuation_id replays persisted bounded evidence without duplicating network fetch, candidate cache, or continuation evidence
stale progress, missing authorization, malformed fingerprints, mismatched selection evidence, or changed active snapshot deny before side effects

VSIX protocol validation accepts only bounded target/result fields and rejects raw candidate, registry, provenance, signature, public-key, IP, prompt, command, environment, file, path, credential, or secret fields
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, generic network executor, automatic provenance verification, automatic approval, or automatic activation is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_continue_once_fetches_registry_selected_candidate_and_replays proves selected registry evidence can continue into one candidate fetch/cache result and replay without duplicate candidate fetch ledger events.
VSIX runtimeClient test validates bounded modepack_selected_candidate_fetch_target and modepack_fetch_candidate_result fields while rejecting raw URL/body/provenance fields.
Existing modepack.fetchCandidate and modepack.selectRegistryUpdate tests remain the delegated fetch/cache and trusted selection foundations.
